Removes the `--single-process` flag that gets passed to Chromium on Linux by default. This will make the render faster because multiple processes can be used, but may cause issues with some Linux distributions or if window server libraries are missing.<br />Default: `false` until v4.0.136, then `true` from v4.0.137 on because newer Chrome versions don't allow rendering with the `--single-process` flag. <br />This flag will be removed in Remotion v5.0.

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderFrames()`](/docs/renderer/render-frames#enablemultiprocessonlinux)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#enablemultiprocessonlinux)
- [`renderStill()`](/docs/renderer/render-still#enablemultiprocessonlinux)

## Config file

```tsx twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';

// ---cut---

Config.setChromiumMultiProcessOnLinux(true);
```
